_comment: The ffmpeg supply chain for `bundled` builds (M7 T0). Tracked; the binaries it
describes are not — `just fetch-ffmpeg` reproduces them from these sources.
WHY WE BUILD RATHER THAN DOWNLOAD: the `ffmpeg-static` / `@derhuerst/ffprobe-static`
npm packages ship `--enable-nonfree` binaries, which may not be redistributed at
all — not under GPL, not under anything (verified 2026-08-08 against the installed
package). The one credible prebuilt alternative (Martin Riedl's macOS arm64 release,
static external libraries, every one of which we would have to mirror the
0.3.0 made m4a canonical, and as of T1b this profile has NO external libraries at
all: LAME left with the mp3 encoder and the mp3 muxer, because nothing in lark
writes an mp3 any more. The mp3 demuxer, decoder and parser stay — the one-time
migration has to READ what 0.2.x wrote, and so does import.
The configure line is deliberately path-free: it is compared byte for byte in
accept-pack, so it must not carry whichever directory the build happened to run in.
